# Fresh Frame

> A two-person studio in Chennai, India, building websites, branding and
> custom business automation. Founders: Ganesh Kumar (full-stack developer,
> ML) and Vinothini (frontend developer, product).

Fresh Frame builds a real, working mock of a website before any money
changes hands — not a PDF, not a template preview — and the client decides
whether to continue after seeing it, with zero advance owed either way.
Automations (order/enquiry handling, invoicing, reporting, reminders,
follow-ups) are scoped on a call instead, since a workflow can't be judged
in a five-minute browser preview the way a page can.

## Services

- Websites — landing pages, business/portfolio sites, e-commerce stores, custom web apps
- Business automation — built around how the client's business actually works, not an off-the-shelf tool
- Branding — logo, visual identity, brand kit, website copywriting
- Digital solutions — SEO setup, analytics, domain/hosting, maintenance

## Pricing (India, INR)

- Basic: ₹3,000–6,000 — one page
- Standard: ₹8,000–15,000 — 3–5 pages
- Premium: ₹15,000–30,000 — online ordering/booking, own domain, branding, 30 days support
- Care plan (add-on): ₹500–1,500/month — ongoing maintenance
- Automation and custom products are quoted per job after a scoping call
